title: Kurumba
text: Linguistically, Kurumba, as well as the state languages of the region, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada, belong to the Southern branch (SDr.I) of the Dravidian language family found in the Indian sub‐continent from Afganisthan to Sri Lanka, but spoken dominantly only in South India.
